summary: Verified PR #607's live design against the diff and reviews: 8 a-la-carte HasX connective mixins (no HasBot, primitive HasNot), with new maintainer signals report 01 missed (eric-wieser: 'Has prefix is a Lean-3-ism' + single-file ask; chenson's open CHANGES_REQUESTED on the _def lemma direction; benbrastmckie's 2026-06-17 coordination comment already posted). Recommendation: engage incrementally, NOT with a competing architecture. Two corrections drive it: reuse Mathlib's existing Bot/Top classes instead of minting HasBot (reuse-first + Lean-3-ism), and a primitive HasNot does NOT block faithful registration since HasNot.not can be the derived neg (= imp bot), as #607's own diff already does. Report 02 supplies a priority-ordered, human-authorable review skeleton and flags the #607-base-vs-fork-main divergence as the key rebase risk.
